scope: Local hardware-session preparation and temporary-fixture tests only. No SSH, robot access, ROS graph invocation, installation, restore or motor command.

verified.inventory_execution: Temporary nonsensitive fixture directories only, without --ros

closed_gaps: Explicit discovered component paths supported; default candidates labeled unverified, never installed truth.
Inventory includes installed neural-controller library and Python launch-file hashes.
Hash/copy reader rejects source symlinks including ancestor traversal, special files and common credential patterns; stable-file metadata checked before/after read.
Explicit reviewed-file backup and separate staged-transfer artifact manifest; new private output only, original source unchanged, no executable copied files.
Independent manifest SHA pins transfer identity; per-file verification rejects corruption, extras, missing files and incomplete capture.
Checklist covers current reference/finite/interactive readonly capability contracts, transient nonce exclusion, and slew-bearing policy contract.
Checklist distinguishes preserved shipped default, local simulation Sit asset and unpromoted research candidates.
Reopen the anchored no-follow source path after copying to reject atomic replacement as well as mutation of an open file.
Staged-transfer entries require individually reviewed expected_sha256 pins; baseline plans may pin inventory hashes.
open_before_robot_changes: Discover actual Pi paths and launch invocation; pi@mts reachability is not established by this review.
Read current neural controller model_path and match actual loaded file paths; directory candidates may miss arbitrary installed locations.
Record battery/calibration/mechanical state and the exact previously approved behavior.
Preserve selected installed files plus uncommitted relevant source and package/build identity; this explicit-file tool is not a full checkout snapshot.
Verify an off-Pi backup with the independently recorded manifest digest before replacement.
Resolve symlink-install targets explicitly and retain link mappings; copying the compiled library alone may omit dependencies.
Establish the real stop/restart/rollback procedure with the operator; file integrity is not executable rollback or physical readiness.
limitations: Credential screens reduce accidental capture; explicit file review remains necessary and no arbitrary-content secrecy guarantee is made.
The helper creates no complete application/OS image, package installation or automatic restore.
No current robot policy hashes, runtime capabilities or loaded driver bounds are known.
New policies retain their hardware/TA validation gates; this task does not select a deployment candidate.
Per-file capture times and stable-file checks are recorded; this is not an atomic multi-file or running-application snapshot. Quiet relevant writers before capture.
